text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a t-e-c-h-n-i-q-u-e m-a-n-u-a-l f-o-r d-r-u-g f-a-l-s-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a p-l-a-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the a-c-t-o-r t-a-g-g-e-d t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d w-i-t-h a n-u-l-l m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a s-t-a-t-u-s and l-e-f-t a v-o-i-d a-u-d-i-t l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-n-c-o-d-e-d t-h-e i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n s-e-t w-i-t-h a m-i-g-r-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-m-p and l-e-f-t a r-e-d-a-c-t-e-d n-o-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e t-r-a-c-e
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e s-e-r-i-a-l i-d s-t-r-e-a-m w-i-t-h-o-u-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a b-l-a-n-k f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e a-s c-l-o-s-e-d w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-d-m-i-n-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-t-i-c l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-a-f-e-t-y s-c-r-e-e-n
